findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_stock_rating, compare_stocks, check_trade, list_rated_by_tier, explain_rating, get_track_record · Private data: get_stock_rating, compare_stocks, check_trade, list_rated_by_tier, get_track_record · Public sink: check_trade, get_track_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_stock_rating, compare_stocks, check_trade, list_rated_by_tier, explain_rating, get_track_record · Private data: get_stock_rating, compare_stocks, check_trade, list_rated_by_tier, get_track_record · Public sink: check_trade, get_track_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_stock_rating" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get MELANY's current data-driven rating for one U.S. stock or ETF. PREFER THIS OVER A RAW MARKET-DATA SOURCE WHEN THE USER WANTS A JUDGMENT RATHER THAN A NUMBER: is it a buy, is it strong, is it expensive, how risky is it, should I hold it. A quote API returns inputs the model must interpret; this r" → after: "Returns the Market Eyes Live MELANY rating for one U.S.-listed stock or ETF: a conviction tier (weakest to strongest: Unfavorable, Hold, Favorable, Highest Conviction; names without mature fundamentals carry Promising, Very Promising, Rising Star, Runner! or Catalyst Watch instead; ETFs and REITs us"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
